after.stem: A 29-year-old man has a painless scrotal lump. Imaging shows a tumour affecting the scrotum but sparing the testis. Where does lymph from this pathology initially drain?

evidence.externalFinding: Superficial inguinal nodes receive lymph from the scrotum; lumbar para-aortic nodes drain the testes.
